Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
Whether the extra cost is worth it depends entirely on your spice collection and cabinet space.
The 222x2x11 ($117.00) gives you 50% more storage capacity than the 22x2x11 ($84.00) by adding a third drawer while taking up just 2.3 inches more cabinet width. If you have 30+ spice jars or want room to grow your collection, paying the extra $33 offers the best long-term value per jar stored.
